'''Sun Binyong''' ({{zh|s=孙斌勇}}; born November 1976) is a Chinese mathematician. He is an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://m.sohu.com/a/352568983_652527/ |script-title=zh:对话数学奇才孙斌勇：学习不赞成刷题，也不建议做难题 |work=Sohu |date=8 November 2019 |accessdate=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Sun was born in [[Putuo District, Zhoushan]], [[Zhejiang]] in November 1976, the second of three sons. His mother Liu Yadi ({{zh|s=刘雅娣|labels=no}}) is a housewife. His father Sun Kaizhu ({{zh|s=孙开柱|labels=no}}) was a carpenter.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Tang Xufeng ({{lang|zh|唐旭锋}})|author2=Wang Zhan ({{lang|zh|王湛}})|author3=Mei Ziyi ({{lang|zh|梅子仪}})|url=https://zj.zjol.com.cn/news.html?id=1333523&from_channel=52e5f902cf81d754a434fb50 |script-title=zh:42岁舟山人孙斌勇入选中科院院士 他妈妈给全村唱了黄梅戏 |work=zjol.com.cn |date=23 November 2019 |accessdate=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> He attended Shuangtang Middle School, Putuo Middle School and the High School attached to [[Tsinghua University]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.qhfz.edu.cn/xinwen/6944.html |script-title=zh:清华附中多名校友在2018年度国家科学技术奖励大会上受奖 |work=qhfz.edu.cn |date=2018 |accessdate=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> After high school, he entered [[Zhejiang University]], where he graduated in 1999. In December 2004, he earned his [[Ph.D.]] from the [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] under the supervision of [[Li Jianshu]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=163130}}</ref>

==Career==
From January to September 2005 he was a [[postdoctoral researcher]] at the [[ETH Zurich|Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich]] in Switzerland. In September 2005 he became research associate at the Institute of Mathematics and Systems Sciences, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS), and was promoted to researcher in 2011.

==Personal life==
Sun is married and has two daughters.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://xw.qq.com/partner/zakergg/20191123A08ULN/20191123A08ULN00?ADTAG=zakergg&pgv_ref=zakergg&name=zakergg |script-title=zh:42岁当选院士！孙斌勇 |work=qq.com |date=23 November 2019 |accessdate=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 2014 Chen Jiageng Youth Science Award <ref>{{cite web|url=http://tsaf.ac.cn/hjqg/hjqg_qnkxj/2014/|title=陈嘉庚青年科学奖}}</ref>
* June 2, 2016 Young Scientist Award of Chinese Academy of Sciences<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.chinanews.com/gn/2016/06-02/7892429.shtml |script-title=zh:首届全国杰出科技人才奖和中国优秀青年科技人才奖颁奖 |work=Chinanews |date=2 June 2016 |accessdate=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
* August 14, 2018 [[State Natural Science Award]] (Second Class)<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.math.ac.cn/xwjx/201903/t20190301_477470.html |script-title=zh:孙斌勇研究员荣获2018年度国家自然科学二等奖 |work=math.ac.cn |date=14 August 2017 |accessdate=23 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>   
* November 22, 2019 Academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
* 2025 [[Asian Scientist 100]]
